descriptions.tumor_skin_epithelial_bcc: Aggregates and nests of uniform basaloid epithelial cells displaying high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, dark hyperchromatic nuclei, scant basophilic cytoplasm, and prominent peripheral nuclear palisading, typically surrounded by distinct peritumoral retraction clefts and a loose, fibromyxoid stroma.
descriptions.tumor_skin_epithelial_sqcc: Infiltrative nests and sheets of atypical polygonal epithelial cells with abundant glassy eosinophilic cytoplasm, prominent intercellular bridges, and pleomorphic enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli, frequently displaying concentric lamellar keratin pearls and dyskeratosis embedded within a desmoplastic stroma.
descriptions.tumor_skin_melanoma_melanoma: Infiltrative dermal sheets and confluent intraepidermal nests of highly pleomorphic epithelioid or spindled melanocytes featuring enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei, prominent macronucleoli, abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm, frequent atypical mitoses, and granular brown melanin pigment.
descriptions.tumor_skin_naevus_naevus: Well-circumscribed nests and cords of monomorphic, round-to-ovoid melanocytes with uniform, bland nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, demonstrating vertical maturation from cohesive superficial dermal clusters into smaller, dispersed, spindle-shaped neurotized cells within a collagenous stroma, accompanied by variable fine granular brown melanin pigment.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_epidermis_epidermis: Normal epidermis is characterized by an orderly stratified squamous keratinizing epithelium displaying a basal layer of cuboidal-to-columnar cells along undulating rete ridges, transitioning upward through polygonal spinous keratinocytes with distinct intercellular bridges, flattened granular cells laden with coarse basophilic keratohyalin granules, and an overlying acellular, compact-to-basket-weave eosinophilic stratum corneum.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_dermis_dermis: Wavy, dense, eosinophilic collagen bundles arranged in an irregular, interwoven fibrous network containing sparsely scattered, slender, spindle-shaped fibroblasts and delicate, thin-walled capillaries.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_subcutis_subcutis: Subcutaneous adipose tissue characterized by lobular sheets of mature, uniform adipocytes featuring large, optically clear lipid vacuoles, delicate cell borders creating a distinct honeycomb network, and small, flattened, eccentric nuclei compressed against the cell periphery, partitioned by thin collagenous fibrovascular septa.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_hairfollicle_hairfollicle: Normal cutaneous hair follicles present as concentric, multilayered epithelial cylinders or rounded nests surrounded by a hyaline basement membrane and fibrous sheath, featuring a basaloid outer root sheath with peripheral palisading, inner trichohyalin-containing layers, and a central dense keratinized hair shaft.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_sebaceousglands_sebaceousg: Normal dermal sebaceous glands exhibit lobulated clusters of large polyhedral mature sebocytes containing abundant, pale, microvacuolated or foamy cytoplasm and centrally located scalloped nuclei, surrounded by a thin peripheral rim of small, flattened basaloid germinative cells.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_sweatglands_sweatglands: Clusters of well-circumscribed, coiled tubular cross-sections in the dermis composed of secretory units lined by simple cuboidal-to-columnar epithelial cells with pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm surrounded by an outer layer of spindle-shaped myoepithelial cells, admixed with excretory ducts lined by a distinct bi-layered ring of small, dark cuboidal cells featuring a prominent, dense eosinophilic luminal cuticle.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_vessel_vessel: Cutaneous vascular structures characterized by patent or collapsed luminal spaces lined by a continuous monolayer of flattened, attenuated endothelial cells with elongated nuclei, enveloped by variable concentric layers of eosinophilic smooth muscle cells or thin collagenous adventitia, often containing intraluminal biconcave erythrocytes.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_nerves_nerves: Cutaneous nerve fascicles present as well-circumscribed, rounded to serpentine bundles enveloped by a delicate perineurial sheath, composed of wavy spindle-shaped Schwann cells with elongated, tapered nuclei embedded within a pale eosinophilic, finely fibrillar stroma with subtle neuroaxonal clefts.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_muscle_skeletal: Histopathology reveals well-organized fascicles of elongated, brightly eosinophilic cylindrical myofibers with distinct transverse cross-striations and multiple uniform, flattened nuclei positioned peripherally beneath the sarcolemma, separated by delicate fibrovascular endomysial connective tissue.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_chondraltissue_chondraltis: Benign chondral tissue displays rounded to ovoid chondrocytes with central dark nuclei residing individually or in small isogenous groups within distinct clear lacunae, embedded throughout an abundant, homogeneous to fibrillar, basophilic to amphophilic extracellular matrix.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_elastosis_elastosis: Superficial to mid-dermis containing dense, band-like accumulations of thick, fragmented, tangled, and clumped basophilic to slate-gray amorphous and fibrillar degenerated elastic fibers replacing the normal eosinophilic collagen architecture, often situated beneath a thin subepidermal grenz zone.
descriptions.nontumor_skin_necrosis_necrosis: Amorphous, hypereosinophilic tissue demonstrating extensive loss of cellular architecture with anucleate ghost cell outlines, granular debris, scattered basophilic karyorrhectic nuclear dust, and disrupted collagen bundles in the absence of viable neoplastic proliferation.

prompt_template: You are a pathologist writing a single, dense sentence that a vision-language model's text encoder will compare against histopathology image patches. Describe the class {class_name!r} (dataset: {dataset}) in ONE sentence, focused on visually distinctive tissue morphology (cell shape, arrangement, texture) -- not clinical significance or diagnosis. Output only the sentence, no preamble, no quotes.
